description: Voies ferrées - Dijon Métropole is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
